Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 4,150.00 (this is the filer's FIRST and only report of the cycle, so period = year-to-date) and is NOT summed as an increment. THE LOAN LADDER (per addendum B3): row 1 is 'Diane Garcia Loan to Campaign' 3,000.00 written on the CONTRIBUTIONS schedule; Box A 'Balance at Beginning' prints a typed 0, so there is no beginning-balance slot for it, and the schedule's own subtotal 4,150.00 (which includes it) is what Box B repeats. The page therefore books the loan AS a contribution row, and it is published as one. Box F = A + B = 4,150.00 and the unlettered close box = F - D = 4,150.00 - 2,328.82 = 1,821.18, exactly as printed.
